jobs.title: Event Security
jobs.description:
Job Summary: Austin FC
Provide security detail as outlined in the post orders and establish working relationships with customers, local law enforcement and fire departments. Security personnel will always perform job duties with a constant awareness of surroundings, making note of all activity that takes place in the assigned area. Security Officers must maintain a professional image and always demonstrate excellent customer service.

Basic Functions:
  • Control of entrances and movement of pedestrian and vehicle traffic.
  • Patrol of buildings and perimeters.
  • Escort of material and personnel.
  • Inspection of security and fire exposures.
  • Special assignments.
Responsibilities:
Duties may vary depending on department size, organizational structure, geographic location and post assignments. Reasonable accommodations may be made to allow for certain ADA requirements. Overall general function of officers is to provide security detail as described below (Note: duties may vary depending on post orders):
  • Be on time and report to post in full uniform.
  • Maintain professional image that includes greeting customers, visitors and employees in a polite and friendly manner.
  • Be proactive in knowing all revisions to post orders and general information distributed by the customer and AFS.
  • Patrol physical property or maintain fixed post position, being diligent to report any suspicious activity and investigate accidents and criminal acts.
  • Monitor cameras or equipment in a continuous fashion as outlined in the post orders.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of all emergency policies, procedures and regulations to be able to respond to alarms, incidents and emergency situations.
  • Complete Daily Activity Reports, Log Book entries, Incident Reports and all relevant reports related to job assignment.
  • Make recommendations to management on better safety and loss prevention processes as identified during daily routine.
  • Have knowledge of any life safety systems, fire panels, CCTV system computer, and other such equipment to complete job assignments. Ensure continuous and safe operation of all elevators and access doors. Know authorized contractor personnel who are responsible for maintenance and upkeep of equipment.
  • Ensure training and compliance guidelines are met as outlined by AFS and other agencies regulating the customer / market.
  • Communicate on a daily basis with Security Supervisor any new Security Issues or changes that need to be considered or implemented.
Skills and Abilities:
  • A security officer is to be honest, alert and well-disciplined as the custodians of employee and customer property and safety.
  • Constant and dedicated vigilance.
  • Strong customer service skills, exemplifying Andy Frain Services Mission Statement.
  • Ability to be a hands-on, results oriented employee, handling multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to facilitate progressive change, work as part of a team and follow directions.
  • Work with a sense of urgency.
  • Strong oral and written communications skills.
This description portrays in general terms the type and level(s) of work performed and is not intended to be all-inclusive, nor the specific duties of any one incumbent. Andy Frain Services reserves the right to modify, supplement, delete or augment the duties and responsibilities specified in the position description, in the Company's sole and absolute discretion. Duties other than those expressly specified may be assigned from time to time.

jobs.title: Chief of Security
jobs.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

Regents School of Austin seeks an experienced, strategic, and visionary Chief of Safety & Security to lead and oversee a comprehensive campus safety and security program. Serving a community of 1,050+ students and 200+ faculty/staff on an 83-acre suburban campus, this position ensures that the Regents community thrives in a safe, Christ-centered environment.

This role requires a leader with extensive experience in law enforcement, emergency management, or security operations, capable of balancing strong security measures with the warmth and vibrancy of a private school community. The Chief of Safety & Security is responsible for anticipating and mitigating threats, leading first response efforts, and cultivating a culture of safety throughout the school.

This is an armed position; the individual must hold appropriate credentials and maintain all training necessary to provide a high level of protection on campus. The role reports to the Chief Operating Officer and collaborates closely with the Senior Team, serving as Incident Commander during emergencies and leading a security advisory team composed of internal and external experts.

The ideal candidate is a Christ-follower who integrates faith into professional practice, is deeply committed to the safety of students and staff, and is passionate about developing a security program recognized for excellence nationwide.

Timeline

We will be interviewing for this position mid/late September.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Risk Management

  • Serve as Incident Commander and first responder to all emergencies on campus
  • Lead strategic development, implementation, and continuous improvement of campus safety and security programs
  • Evaluate the school's overall risk profile, including facilities, transportation, field trips, athletic events, and off-campus experiences
  • Conduct annual internal safety and security assessments; facilitate an external audit every three years
  • Develop the department's annual operating plan aligned with Regents' strategic objectives
  • Maintain situational awareness of internal and external threats; proactively implement preventative measures

Program Oversight & Training

  • Develop, schedule, and lead training programs, drills, and assessments for employees, volunteers, coaches, and substitutes
  • Ensure policies, procedures, and emergency operational plans are reviewed and updated annually
  • Oversee campus security technology, including visitor management systems, access control, license plate recognition, and surveillance equipment
  • Manage the department's annual operating budget with a focus on stewardship, efficiency, and alignment with strategic priorities

Collaboration & Community Relations

  • Serve as primary liaison with local law enforcement, fire, and emergency management agencies
  • Coordinate with health authorities for community health concerns and emergency responses
  • Support investigations involving students, staff, and faculty as needed
  • Host security-focused gatherings and serve as a consultant to other Christian schools
  • Maintain a visible presence on campus while fostering a positive, approachable relationship with students, staff, and families

Culture & Team Integration

  • Uphold and model Regents' Christ-centered culture, demonstrating servant leadership, grace, and integrity in all interactions
  • Develop strong relationships with colleagues to foster teamwork, relational unity, and spiritual growth
  • Support team members in school-wide initiatives and operational goals
  • Act as a "culture-keeper" to ensure security programs align with the school's mission and values

Faith Alignment

All Regents staff and volunteers must subscribe to our Purpose, Mission, Philosophy, Objectives, and Doctrinal Statement (Article II). Board-adopted statements providing additional clarity include:

  • Chicago Statement on Biblical Inerrancy
  • Nashville Statement: A Coalition for Biblical Sexuality

Nashville Statement: A Coalition for Biblical Sexuality

jobs.title: Security Guard for Events
jobs.description:
A2A Security is looking for a reliable and professional Security Officer for Events in Austin, TX. Your primary role will be to ensure the safety and security of various events, control access for guests, and maintain a secure atmosphere. This position plays a crucial role in preventing incidents and adhering to safety standards. Key Responsibilities: - Control access for guests and personnel attending events. - Vigilantly monitor event areas for unauthorized individuals, suspicious behavior, and safety risks. - React promptly and effectively to incidents and emergencies. - Provide help and information to guests when necessary. - Write incident reports and keep precise records of activities. - Enforce event rules and regulations to guarantee a secure environment. Requirements: - A valid Texas Security Guard License is mandatory. - Prior experience in event security is preferred. - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are necessary. - Reliability, punctuality, and professionalism are critical attributes. - Ability to remain calm and effective in stressful situations. Working Conditions: - This is a part-time position. - Shifts may include evenings and weekends depending on event schedules. - Competitive pay starting at $18.00 per hour, commensurate with experience. How to Apply: Interested applicants should submit their resumes along with their contact details. Selected candidates will be contacted directly for an interview. Join our team as a Security Officer for Events and be a key player in ensuring the safety of our events and gatherings. In this active role, you will implement essential security measures to protect attendees, staff, and property. Your proactive efforts will foster a secure environment where guests can fully enjoy their experience. Responsibilities include: - Monitoring event locations through surveillance tools like CCTV to spot suspicious activities or security breaches. - Conducting thorough access control checks, including background verification of attendees, staff, and vendors. - Responding swiftly to emergencies by following established emergency protocols, including first aid, CPR, AED use, and fire safety. - Managing crowd control and conflict resolution to create a safe and pleasant environment for all. - Documenting security incidents and unusual activities in detailed reports. - Patrolling event areas to identify potential hazards or security weaknesses, ensuring compliance with security requirements. - Assisting with lifting or manual tasks needed for event setup or breakdown. Skills: - Strong monitoring skills using CCTV systems and other surveillance tools. - Background in military or law enforcement is beneficial for managing high-pressure situations effectively. - Certification in first aid, CPR, AED operation, and fire safety for confident emergency response. - Proficient in writing incident reports with a focus on accuracy and detail. - Experience with access control systems and performing background checks for authorized entry. - Skilled in conflict management and customer service to ensure positive interactions while maintaining safety. - Knowledgeable in physical security practices, including Taser use and firearm handling (where permitted). - Capacity to perform routine patrols, CCTV monitoring, loss prevention, and compliance with security regulations in diverse settings. Become an integral part of our team as a Security Officer for Events and help us create secure and enjoyable experiences for everyone involved!Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and vigilant Security Guard for Events to ensure the safety and security of attendees, staff, and property during various events. This role involves proactive surveillance, access control, emergency response, and conflict management to create a safe environment where everyone can enjoy the event experience. The ideal candidate will be energetic, detail-oriented, and committed to maintaining high standards of security compliance while providing excellent customer service. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to be an integral part of vibrant event environments, ensuring safety with professionalism and confidence.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor event venues through CCTV surveillance systems and perform regular patrols to identify potential security risks or suspicious activity.
  • Control access points using advanced access control systems, verifying credentials, performing background checks when necessary, and managing attendee flow efficiently.
  • Respond swiftly to incidents or emergencies by executing established emergency response procedures, including fire safety protocols and first aid administration.
  • Write detailed incident reports documenting any security breaches, accidents, or unusual occurrences during events.
  • Manage conflict de-escalation techniques to resolve disputes peacefully while maintaining a calm and authoritative presence.
  • Conduct thorough background checks on staff or vendors as required to ensure compliance with security regulations.
  • Operate specialized security equipment such as Taser devices, AEDs (Automated External Defibrillators), firearms (where permitted), and perform manual handling tasks including heavy lifting when necessary for crowd control or equipment setup.
  • Collaborate with law enforcement agencies during investigations or incidents, providing accurate information and support as needed.
  • Perform routine patrolling of the venue’s perimeter and interior spaces to uphold physical security standards and prevent unauthorized access.
  • Assist in emergency evacuation procedures ensuring all attendees are guided safely out of the venue in case of fire, medical emergency, or other hazards.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in security roles, preferably within event environments or related fields such as military or law enforcement backgrounds.
  • Strong knowledge of surveillance techniques including CCTV operation and monitoring.
  • Certification in first aid, CPR (Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation), AED operation, and fire safety is highly desirable.
  • Ability to perform manual handling tasks including heavy lifting safely and effectively.
  • Excellent communication skills for incident report writing, customer service interactions, and conflict management.
  • Familiarity with access control systems and security technology such as CCTV cameras and alarm systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to remain calm under pressure while executing emergency response procedures confidently.
  • Physical fitness to stand for extended periods, patrol large venues, and perform physically demanding tasks when required.
  • Knowledge of legal regulations related to security operations and compliance standards applicable in public event settings.

Join us in delivering secure, enjoyable experiences at every event! Your vigilance makes a difference in creating safe environments where everyone can thrive.

Pay: $18.00 per hour

  • security guard license (Required)
